Title: Ballon d'Or
Details: Won a world-record 8 Ballon d'Or awards in football history.

Title: FC Barcelona Career
Details: Played 17 senior seasons with 778 appearances scoring 672 goals and 303 assists winning 35 trophies.

Title: Paris Saint-Germain Era
Details: Signed two-year contract in France making 75 appearances with 32 goals and 35 assists winning 3 trophies (2 Ligue 1 titles 1 Trophee des Champions).

Title: Inter Miami CF Era
Details: Joined Major League Soccer club in USA wearing number 10 leading them to their first-ever trophy Leagues Cup 2023 and Supporters Shield 2024.

Title: FIFA World Cup Champion
Details: Captained Argentina to win the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar scoring 7 goals and winning the Golden Ball award.

Title: Copa America Champion
Details: Captained Argentina to defeat Brazil 1-0 at the Maracana Stadium winning Best Player and joint top goalscorer.

Title: Copa America Back-to-Back
Details: Captained Argentina to retain the Copa America title defeating Colombia 1-0 in the final in the United States.

Title: Finalissima Winner
Details: Defeated European Champions Italy 3-0 at Wembley Stadium named Player of the Match.

Title: Olympic Gold Medal
Details: Won Olympic Gold with the Argentina Under-23 team at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

Title: Guinness World Record Most Goals in Calendar Year
Details: Scored 91 official goals in the calendar year 2012 (79 for Barcelona and 12 for Argentina).

Title: European Golden Shoe
Details: Won 6 European Golden Shoes as the top league goalscorer in Europe (2010 2012 2013 2017 2018 2019).

Title: Sextuple with FC Barcelona
Details: Won all six official competitions in 2009 under manager Pep Guardiola (La Liga Copa del Rey Champions League Spanish Super Cup UEFA Super Cup Club World Cup).

Title: MSN Treble Trio
Details: Formed historic attacking trio MSN with Luis Suarez and Neymar Jr winning the treble (La Liga Copa del Rey UEFA Champions League) in 2015.

Title: Early Life and Diagnosis
Details: Born June 24 1987 in Rosario Santa Fe Argentina diagnosed with growth hormone deficiency (GHD) at age 10 moving to Barcelona La Masia in 2001.

Title: Family and Children
Details: Married childhood sweetheart Antonela Roccuzzo in 2017 with three sons: Thiago Mateo and Ciro.

Title: Leo Messi Foundation
Details: Established foundation in 2007 supporting healthcare education and sports for vulnerable children also UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador.

Title: Career Total Official Trophies
Details: Most decorated football player in history with over 45 official team trophies across club and international senior career.

Title: All-Time La Liga Top Scorer
Details: Scored all-time Spanish league record 474 goals in 520 appearances.
